subject.title: fix(agents): memoize exec auto-reviewer verdicts for identical requests (#102249)

question: May one low-risk model reviewer verdict be reused for repeated executions, and if so must reuse be limited to gateway requests bound to the same canonical resolved executable?
rationale: Reusing an `allow-once` verdict changes the authorization frequency and therefore needs an explicit owner decision about whether canonical gateway-only reuse preserves the intended exec-review security contract.

options.title: Allow canonical gateway reuse
options.body: Permit bounded reuse only for gateway requests whose full reviewer context and canonical resolved executable are identical, while continuing to review every node request.

options.title: Allow cross-host textual reuse
options.body: Accept the current broader command-context memo even though executable identity and node preparation are not represented in the key.

options.title: Preserve one-review-per-exec
options.body: Reject verdict memoization because `allow-once` should always correspond to one execution attempt regardless of cost.

recommendation.title: Allow canonical gateway reuse
recommendation.body: Permit bounded reuse only for gateway requests whose full reviewer context and canonical resolved executable are identical, while continuing to review every node request.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the most recent identified contributor to the same exec auto-reviewer implementation and tests.
